title: Key West Tiki Bar Boat to Popular Sand Bar with Turquoise Waters
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience the Florida Keys like a true Conch! Our 4-hour Backcountry Sandbar Excursion takes you to a stunning location chosen by your captain based on the day's weather and tides. Immerse yourself in the intoxicating beauty of turquoise waters and deep blue skies. Keep an eye out for the incredible local wildlife – you might spot rays, turtles, fish, and even playful dolphins! Once we arrive at the sandbar, you'll have ample time to swim, soak up the sun, and simply unwind in this island paradise. Just bring your swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, and any snacks and drinks (including alcohol) you'd like to enjoy. This private trip is perfect for up to 6 passengers and runs daily from noon to 4 pm.
